description: For finite symbol sets \(S,T\), models \(M,N\) of theories \(T_1,T_2\), an isomorphism \(e\) of their common reducts, and a chosen \(m_0\in M\), the specified structure obtained by keeping the first interpretations, transporting private second-side interpretations along \(e\), and using \(m_0\) for unused functions satisfies both translated theories on the domain \(M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.glue_structure_models.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S T : Finset L.Symbols) {M : Type w} {N : Type w'}
  [sM : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage S).Structure M]
  [sN : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage T).Structure N] [Nonempty M] [Nonempty N]
  (e : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage (S ∩ T)).Equiv M N)
  (T₁ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage S).Theory)
  (T₂ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage T).Theory) (h₁ : M ⊨ T₁) (h₂ : N ⊨ T₂)
  (m₀ : M) :
  have e₀ := e.toEquiv;
  M ⊨
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion S).onTheory T₁ ∪
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion T).onTheory T₂
